title: Create: Void Tank
description: Create Mod addon that adds a tank that voids any pumped in fluid
body: # Create Void Tank Pipe it in and forget it. The Create Void Tank is a compact mod that adds a single block — the **Void Tank** — which accepts fluid from any side and instantly destroys it. It never fills up, never backs up your pipes, and scales into multi-block structures just like Create's own fluid tanks. ### Disclaimer This mod was developed using AI and this description was written by AI too. If you dont like that, dont use the Mod. Quick Features -------------- - New block: **Void Tank** — accepts fluids from any side and voids them instantly - Multi-block connectivity (up to 3×3 × 16 tall), mirrors Create's fluid tank behaviour - Toggle glass windows by right-clicking with a Wrench - Three activation modes configurable per-server: - `ALWAYS_ACTIVE` — voids continuously (default) - `REQUIRES_HEAT` — needs a heat source below (campfire, fire, lava, or Blaze Burner) - `REQUIRES_REDSTONE` — only voids while receiving a redstone signal - When heat mode is active, the minimum heat level is configurable (Smouldering / Kindled / Seething)
